title: Courses with their teachers
statementMd:
List each course title with its teacher's name (courses without a teacher are omitted).

Expected columns: `title`, `teacher`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.title, t.name AS teacher FROM courses c JOIN teachers t ON t.id = c.teacher_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
